# Pipedream Ventures

Pipedream Ventures is an AI product studio based in Columbus, Ohio.

## What we do

- AI product and workflow sprints
- Web, iOS, Android, API, and agent development
- Product strategy, monetization, lifecycle, acquisition, and analytics
- Monthly product and growth operating partnerships

## Selected products

- CancelPMI: https://cancelpmi.app
- Front Porch: https://frontporch.house
- OpenShifts: https://openshifts.co

## Contact

- Website: https://pipedream.ventures
- Email: seth@pipedream.ventures

Pipedream Ventures LLC is led by Seth Miller, founder of Rapchat.
